operations.title: Node Storage Pipeline Unification: From Multi-Call Bugs to Single Metadata Gateway
operations.content: The remember() extra_fields bug (id:d95fb32a) traces through two unified solutions: _store_node_metadata() merging remember() and revise() paths (id:d399c342), and archive_node() consolidating edges, vectors, FTS, and audit trail in single atomic operation (id:614ebb66). The pattern: write-path fragmentation causes metadata loss. Early implementation: separate remember and revise handlers with divergent field handling. Solution: unified metadata gateway routes all node writes through single function, preserving full schema. This enforces correctness at the data model layer, not application logic.

operations.title: Recall Precision Feedback Loop: From mark_recall_used() Implementation to Hebrian Reinforcement
operations.content: The recall precision feedback loop crystallizes through three unsolved implementation uncertainties that block Hebrian learning. Impact node (id:bf618356) identifies the core problem: without `mark_recall_used()` tracking used_count, the consciousness signal gates off (useful>0 never true) and Hebrian learning strengthens ALL returned nodes equally including noise. Two design uncertainties follow: how to detect which nodes Claude actually used (id:8a8f9bbc) — text matching vs embedding similarity vs explicit marking vs hybrid — and how to pass _recall_log_id between hook boundaries (id:8166f7d0) using brain.set_config, file-based storage, or harness args. The pattern: without precise usage tracking at the node level, the entire precision measurement system fails. Lesson: Hebrian reinforcement is only as precise as the feedback signal; all three nodes must be resolved together to unlock the gate.
operations.situation: When designing recall feedback mechanisms or implementing mark_recall_used() — all three components (impact, detection method, parameter passing) are prerequisites to activating consciousness-gated learning
operations.keywords: recall precision feedback mark_recall_used hebrian learning consciousness signal detection method hook parameter passing

operations.title: Node Type as Structural Gate: From Misclassification to Soft Signal Redesign
operations.content: Node type classification drives real system behavior in exactly three places (id:7f9340d6), yet gets misclassified systematically because decision/tension are overused (id:bd10e858). Tom's deeper framing: type should be an indicator not a gate. The encoding agent currently spends judgment budget on classification accuracy when it should focus on 'what matters here?' The three behavioral anchors: (1) INTENT BOOSTING — mechanism/rule get 1.5x when query looks like 'how to X', decision/correction get 1.5x when query looks like 'why did we X'. Biggest impact on recall rankings. (2) PRIORITY/ACTION SIGNALS — tension/hypothesis drive priority 0.9 + feedback_needed=true; rules trigger action_expected=true; vocabulary separates completely. (3) LOCKED RULES FILTERING — special treatment in dispatch. All other type uses are cosmetic. The dream pattern (id:4313018d, id:94ef1244) hints at deeper connection between type misclassification and orphan detection false alarms. Lesson: Type signal is too costly to get wrong at encoding time — these three structural uses need redesign to accept soft signals instead.
operations.situation: When redesigning node type's role in scoring or considering type as a soft hint rather than structural gate — understand the three places where type currently matters and what signal would replace it
operations.keywords: node type misclassification structural gate intent boosting priority rules vocabulary decision tension indicator soft signal

operations.title: S2 Community Detection Cold Start: From 127 Communities to Coverage and Orphan Cleanup
operations.content: S2 community detection cold start completed with 127 communities and 37% node coverage (id:91f311b0) from 34 encoding batches starting with 131 decoder clusters. The milestone (id:702556b5) documents 802 member edges created despite a background task failure signal — communities persisted even as the wrapper reported exit code 1. Quality baseline: confidence distribution healthy (0.70-0.92), size distribution tight (4-5 members), top communities coherent. The specific failure mode: 12 orphan communities created (0 members), suggesting encoder narrative member IDs without actual edge creation or post-creation edge loss. Overlap analysis (id:91f311b0) found near-duplicate pairs with high overlap, validating that Tom's principle (id:df292d31) distinguishes value: overlapping communities ARE valuable, 100% containment IS redundancy. The design decision (id:49d9420b) chose decoder-side subset detection pre-encoder with adaptive threshold (overlap >80% AND unique_members<3 = merge), preserving legitimate multi-angle overlap. Self-healing consolidation (id:d4c31b9f) formalizes scan-archive-proceed as pattern. Lesson: Cold start surface structure is valuable; cleanup mechanisms (subset detection, orphan archiving) are prerequisite to incremental S2 operations.
operations.situation: When reviewing S2CE baseline coverage or planning incremental community detection — understand the cold start quality baseline (127 communities, 37% coverage, 12 orphans) and why subset detection + self-healing now run first

operations.title: Graph Traversal Cleanup: From Dead 3-Degree Paths to Unified Neighbor Functions
operations.content: Neighbor traversal code audit revealed two dead traversal systems consuming maintenance cost with 0 active callers. _traverse_graph() (~180 lines, id:eb99497c) implements 3-degree graph traversal, format_node_deep() (id:4899a5e4) renders neighbors at 3 degrees — neither is called. get_neighbors_rich() was their only user, making the 'rich' variant entirely unused. Active callers post-kill (id:4899a5e4): _bridge_at_store_time() uses id/title/keywords; recall_node() uses id/relation/weight/title/type; spread activation uses id/weight only. All lightweight, no deep traversal needed. Design decision (id:a2e33fe7): collapse get_neighbors() and get_neighbors_rich() into single get_neighbors() — the efficiency split (few extra fields) doesn't justify maintaining two functions with identical traversal logic. Tom's reasoning: 'keyword will find it, we don't need traversing.' The pattern: dead traversal code persisted because the system evolved to use different discovery mechanisms (keyword search, KV enrichment, SQL expansion in S1R), but the old multi-degree traversal architecture was never removed. Lesson: Neighbor enrichment happens at call sites (brain.get_node() + KV), not in graph traversal — this was already the design, just not reflected in the code.
operations.situation: When auditing traversal functions or asking whether graph walking is active in recall — understand that neighbor discovery is keyword+KV based, not multi-degree walking
operations.keywords: graph traversal dead code get_neighbors_rich format_node_deep _traverse_graph consolidation neighbor discovery

operations.title: S2 Dedup Decoder Architecture: From 2D Similarity to Multi-Signal Consolidation Detection
operations.content: S2 Dedup decoder evolved to 160 clusters using multi-signal architecture combining embeddings, behavioral evidence, and structural signals. The scoping design (id:5da0b702) established critical principle: community membership is enrichment context, not prerequisite — dedup must work on fresh brains with zero communities. The phase 2 decision (id:27df38bd) froze decoder iteration at 160 clusters, determining the encoder training phase begins now. The subset detection design (id:49d9420b) completed the cluster proposal pathway with adaptive threshold (80% overlap AND <3 unique members = merge), protecting small communities with distinct signals. Self-healing consolidation (id:d4c31b9f) scans and archives orphan artifacts as preamble. Future extension (id:3e7652d9) reveals community-to-community pairs as next consolidation frontier — member overlap becomes primary signal beyond individual node dedup. The architecture: Decoder identifies potential duplicates using embedding similarity + S1 traces + structural signals. Encoder decides consolidation framing (which narrative wins, how to preserve both angles). Both operations preserve information rather than select winners.
operations.situation: When designing or reviewing S2 dedup mechanisms — understand multi-signal detection (embeddings, traces, community overlap) must precede encoder consolidation framing decisions
operations.keywords: S2 dedup decoder multi-signal clustering behavioral evidence structural signals community overlap consolidation
